name: The Human Body
overview: Scripture reveals that the human body is a divine creation, formed in the very image of God, male and female alike, reflecting His intentional design (Genesis 1:27). From the womb, God intimately knows and lovingly fashions each person, as expressed in Psalms 139:13-14 and Jeremiah 1:5, emphasizing our unique and purposeful formation. While the body is fearfully and wonderfully made, the heart within is described as deceitful and desperately wicked, underscoring the need for spiritual renewal beyond physical creation (Jeremiah 17:9). This biblical perspective calls believers to honor their bodies as God’s handiwork while recognizing the fallen nature of the human heart.
